answer: Because of that, capturing the pool demands several independent identities, and each of them needs its own established standing, which only comes from passing graded work. The willow cap is applied at the dawn settlement and visible in the inlet breakdown, which turns a pooling attack into a slow, expensive and publicly visible grind. A single identity may take at most 23% of an epoch's reward pool; anything above the cap is repooled or burned. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
